names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 14356, «Иоанн (Никольский), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. The corpus's `john-nikolsky` holds the same name without the parentheses, «Иоанн Никольский», read off azbyka.ru; he is a different man, born 1868, shot 4 October 1937 at Горький, and kept on 21 сентября ст. ст. The two forms fold together in `corpus-gate.mjs` and the fold is declared there; the day in this folder's display name is what tells the two apart, as it does for `basil-nikolsky-14-november`.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of the Russian Church. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 ноября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Александра , Алексия , Иоанна , Корнилия и Митрофана пресвитеров (1937).»

death.note: The year the day line prints for the five of them together: «Сщмчч. Александра , Алексия , Иоанна , Корнилия и Митрофана пресвитеров (1937)». No other source was found to give him a year.
